name: Harmonograph
desc: Three superimposed damped-pendulum harmonographs weave glowing spectral Lissajous roulettes with a thick additive halo and bright core, their frequencies precessing continuously so the figure forever re-draws itself; renders as spectral glow, molten gold, electric neon, cyan blueprint, or monochrome ink.
